title: Signing in with Google
subtitle: Who talks to whom when you press the Google button

scenes.title: Sign in with Google
scenes.narration: When you press sign in with Google, four parties pass messages back and forth. Your password only ever goes to Google.

messages.label: go to Google, with a one-time state
enter password, agree to share email
back to the shop with a code
signed in, here is a session cookie

steps.say: You press the button. The shop sends you on to Google, with a random value it will check later.
You type your password on Google's own page, never on ours. Google sends you back with a short-lived code.
The shop checks that the random value is the one it gave you, so nobody can slip you their own code.
The shop trades the code for your email address, straight with Google.
It finds your account, or makes one, and signs you in.

scenes.summary: Your password goes **only to Google**; the shop gets a code it trades for your email
bullets: The code works once, and only for a few minutes
The random state ties the answer to the browser that asked
The shop swaps the code server to server, so it never passes through scripts on the page
